QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Chief Stan
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p202##k, the leader of this town. I'm a little nervous about meeting the Chief!\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p202#, the town representative of #m10001000#. He seems a bit strict, but he definitely feels like someone I can rely on.

0.0: As a proper resident of #m10001000#, it wouldn't do to miss out on greeting #p202#. I think it would be best for you to meet #p202# in person and formally introduce yourself. There's absolutely no need to be nervous, so just feel free to pay him a visit.\r\n- #p229#

1.0: Right, so you must be #h0#, the one #p229# was telling me about. Welcome to our town. I've been keeping an eye on you for a while now.
1.1: I've already heard plenty about how much of a help you've been to our town. You are a remarkably diligent fellow, a rare find in this day and age. I trust you will continue to work hard for the sake of #m10001000# in the days ahead.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
